title: sqlalchemy-sql-injection
text: sqlalchemy-sql-injection: Distinct, Having, Group_by, Order_by, and Filter in SQLAlchemy can cause sql injections if the developer inputs raw SQL into the before-mentioned clauses. Use bindParams to securely bind user-input to SQL statements. CWE: CWE-89. Technology: sqlalchemy.
